caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four curved legs, a flat rectangular top, and three drawers on its front side. The table's color is predominantly brown with muted red and gold decorative accents, particularly on the legs and drawer fronts. The surface of the table features intricate designs in a lighter shade, possibly white or light gray, depicting scenes or patterns. The drawer handles are metallic, with the central drawer having a round pull and the two side drawers equipped with drop handles. The legs of the table are cabriole-shaped and decorated with similar red and gold patterns as seen on the body. The drawing is signed in the lower left corner with the text "M. Rosenshield-von Paulin." The background is plain, off-white, and unembellished.
title: Lowboy
